what: Idea 52's data arm for retrain 8b: the top-disagreement sites of S512ppr3 against item 7's from-scratch run (s512pp-scratch-s1), deep-labelled by the default engine (owner's request, 2026-11-09). Data stays outside the repository (~/fork-data/idea52-8b in WSL; sites, stats and this run's files mirrored to C:/Users/<user>/fork-data/idea52-8b).

pool.part: g3j (labelled by S512ppr3, the promoted labeller; the only sealed part since 8a with S512ppr3's labels: g3h and g3i carry S512ppr2's; the docs name no other 8b pool, so g3j by the request's default)
pool.kept_rule: saved (score not 32767) and the trainer's filter: not in check, the move played not a capture or promotion, |score| <= 20,000

networks.a: s512ppr3 (the default; S = 89), embedded in fork-release-2ebacd8
networks.b: s512pp-scratch-s1 (item 7's scratch run, seed 1, S matched to 90; nets/s512pp-scratch-s1.fnet of exp/oracle dcbe8fb, sha256 769bffe2ca857b8a2f6e259afe003b470a97f3c68a90a5d14a13fa7e10946cb5), embedded in fork-scratch-s1-2ebacd8 (FORK_NET); netcheck 446 positions, 0 mismatches against tests/nnue/s512pp-scratch-s1.parity of dcbe8fb
networks.evaluations: fork evalfens of each build (the engines' integer values, side to move's view)

selection.rule: D = |a - b| in cp (idea 52 report's detector 'D in cp'); top set: D >= the D at rank ceil(0.05 n) from the top (the report's top 5%, ties included); sites: a seeded uniform draw of 200,000 from the top set, duplicate positions (first four FEN fields) dropped; controls: 2,000 drawn the same way from the rest

labels.engine: fork-release-2ebacd8: Fork 0.3.0-dev+2ebacd8 (phase-4), WSL clang-release (clang 21.1.8), net s512ppr3, bench 14,149,617 / 1cb0717f040c294d (= tests/bench-s512ppr3.ref; checked by the tool before the first label), sha256 fa8be62a1bfb554018d500c3c41425326028926d395b73afd0b8fec3cb9132aa
labels.search: one thread, Hash 16, ucinewgame before each, go nodes 200000 (ideas.md 52's first-experiment depth), Syzygy 3-4-5; the last reported score, side to move's view, a mate as +-20,000 and flagged
labels.order: the 2,000 controls first, then the sites in draw order (any prefix of the sites is a uniform sample of them)
labels.job: jobctl measure job idea52-8b-sites: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- nice -n 19 bash ~/fork-data/idea52-8b/job.sh (job.sh sha256 b555101a564f4ac2182fa8ee6165550389b4632c7e2ff4a03c1e57db8693adba)

decision_rule: the owner's rule, declared 2026-11-09 before the full set was checked: once the labelling job has labelled all 200,000 sites, `committee_sites.py check OUT --resamples 2000 --seed 20261109` gives the matched ratio (the default net's error on the sites over the controls', the controls reweighted to the sites' 7 |eval| bins, mates and table wins left out) with its 95% percentile bootstrap interval (the sites and the controls each drawn again with replacement); if the whole interval lies below 1.5 (its upper end under 1.5), the arm is dropped from 8b and its data share goes to the control; otherwise (the interval above 1.5 or straddling it) the arm stays in 8b, whose +5 Elo keep-or-drop bar is the real decision. If the job does not finish, the owner decides.
check: committee_sites.py check OUT --resamples 2000 --seed 20261109 (e3b933b), 2026-11-09 6:51 PM EST: 186,941 sites and 1,977 controls with undecided labels; the default net's mean error 224.42 cp on the sites, 76.81 cp on the controls; ratio 2.922 plain, 1.423 matched for |eval|, 95% bootstrap interval [1.263, 1.619] (8b-check.json). The owner's rule: the interval straddles 1.5, so the arm stays in 8b (its +5 Elo keep-or-drop bar decides).
